## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to AI Together.

## Use Case

Describe the use case for this feature. Why would it be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

If you have a specific implementation in mind, please describe it here. Include:

- How the feature should work
- User interface changes (if any)
- API changes (if any)
- Configuration options (if any)

## Alternatives

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Critical - Blocking my usage
- [ ] High - Very important for my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement

## Willing to Contribute

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this feature
- [ ] Yes, I can help test
- [ ] No, I'm only requesting

## Related Issues

- Related to #<!-- (issue number) -->
- Replaces #<!-- (issue number) -->
